name: contextJoins
title: Context joins
description: Table linking a package row to an external environmental dataset at a place and time. Use this for satellite, reanalysis, or station overlays (Sentinel-5P, OpenAQ, ERA5, VIIRS). The package stores the join, not the remote archive.

fields.name: targetType
fields.description: Package table the join is attached to.

fields.name: targetID
fields.description: Identifier in the target table (`deploymentID`, `mediaID`, or `observationID`).

fields.name: datasetID
fields.description: External dataset identifier. Prefer a term from `schemas/core/vocabularies/context-datasets.json`.

fields.name: datasetVersion
fields.description: Product, processing level, or API version.

fields.name: joinTime
fields.description: Timestamp used for the spatiotemporal join. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: joinLatitude
fields.description: Latitude used for the join, if different from the published deployment coordinate.

fields.name: joinRadius
fields.description: Search radius used to find a station or grid cell.

fields.name: sourceURI
fields.description: Resolvable URI for the retrieved record or granule.

fields.name: retrievedAt
fields.description: When the value was retrieved. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: contextJoinComments
fields.description: Comments or notes about the join (e.g. nearest-station name, gap-fill method).
